apis.name: USGS Earthquake Catalog API
apis.summary: Search earthquake event data from the USGS ComCat catalog using time, location, magnitude, and other query parameters.
apis.description: The USGS FDSN Event Web Service exposes ComCat earthquake catalog searches and supports output formats including GeoJSON, CSV, KML, text, and QuakeML. The service documentation recommends real-time GeoJSON feeds for applications displaying recent events where appropriate.
apis.pricingSummary: No API pricing or commercial-use terms are asserted in this candidate record; review the current USGS data and service policies before production use.

authMethods.details: The documented FDSN Event Web Service query interface is publicly callable without an API key; confirm current service policies and limits.

apis.name: Crossref REST API
apis.summary: Retrieve scholarly metadata for works, journals, books, funders, members, and related research records from Crossref.
apis.description: Crossref's REST API provides public access to scholarly metadata. Requests can use the public pool without authentication, identify the caller through the polite pool, or use a Metadata Plus key for premium access with higher request limits and priority support.
apis.pricingSummary: Public and polite access are available without a paid key; Metadata Plus is a premium service. Confirm current commercial and service terms with Crossref.

authMethods.details: Public access requires no authentication; the polite pool can identify a caller using a mailto parameter or agent header.
Metadata Plus uses an API key sent in the crossref-api-key request header.

apis.name: OpenAlex API
apis.summary: Query an open scholarly knowledge graph covering research works, authors, institutions, sources, topics, and related entities.
apis.description: OpenAlex provides a REST API over its scholarly dataset. Basic requests can be made without a key; a free API key increases the daily budget, and paid usage options are available for higher-scale workloads. Query limits and credit costs vary by request type.
apis.pricingSummary: Basic access is free; free API keys provide a larger daily budget and paid usage options are available. Verify current budgets and pricing before production use.

authMethods.details: Basic API queries can be made without a key.
A free or paid API key can be supplied as the api_key query parameter or as a bearer token.

apis.name: The Guardian Open Platform API
apis.summary: Search and retrieve Guardian journalism, including articles, tags, sections, editions, and individual content records.
apis.description: The Guardian Open Platform exposes Guardian content through HTTPS endpoints. API requests require a registered key. Developer access is described for non-commercial use with published request limits; commercial access uses a separately arranged plan and quota.
apis.pricingSummary: Developer access is free for non-commercial use subject to quotas; commercial access is priced according to usage. Review current eligibility and terms.

authMethods.details: Register for an Open Platform key and send it with API requests.

apis.name: Spotify Web API
apis.summary: Access Spotify catalogue metadata and supported user resources, including artists, albums, tracks, playlists, and playback-related features.
apis.description: The Spotify Web API provides REST endpoints for Spotify catalogue and user resources. Requests require authorization using OAuth 2.0 access tokens; the available authorization flow and scopes depend on whether an application accesses public or user-specific data. Rate limits are app-based and can vary by application quota mode.
apis.pricingSummary: This candidate does not assert a standalone API price; developer eligibility, product access, and applicable platform terms must be reviewed before publication.

authMethods.details: All Web API requests require OAuth 2.0 authorization; supported flows include Authorization Code, Authorization Code with PKCE, and Client Credentials for eligible public-data use cases.

apis.name: OpenWeather API
apis.summary: Retrieve weather conditions, forecasts, historical weather, air quality, and related meteorological data through OpenWeather APIs.
apis.description: OpenWeather offers multiple weather API products with product-specific endpoints and subscription plans. API requests require an account API key. Free and paid plans are available, and pricing depends on the selected API product and usage.
apis.pricingSummary: Free plans are available for evaluation and development; paid plans and pay-per-call products are also offered. Exact cost depends on the API product and current plan.

authMethods.details: Create an OpenWeather account and use the API key issued through the account dashboard for API requests.
